layout.note: All 25 sources are placed once, in order: 110 output rows, 83 of them carrying Arabic and Persian together. Piece lengths run 45 code points at the median, so the granularity stays in the manual-v1 range. No fused section labels or crossed pairings were found. Rows were checked against the source in sampled groups by genre and against the corpus-wide statistics for every item.
